deterministic_metrics.syllables: count of whitespace-separated tokens containing a letter, after stripping punctuation (server/story_authoring/checks.py::count_syllables)
deterministic_metrics.length_window_hit: scene syllables within the scene target window (default 600-1000); manuscript total within 7000-11000
deterministic_metrics.cjk: code points flagged by server/story_authoring/script_guard.py (must be 0: invariant)
deterministic_metrics.foreign_words: tokens of Latin letters only that are not valid Vietnamese syllables by the onset+rhyme grammar in checks.py (F25 English code-mixing)
deterministic_metrics.repetition: repeated word-trigram excess per 1,000 syllables (count-1 summed over trigrams seen more than twice) plus duplicate paragraphs by the Huohuo normalized-fingerprint dedupe core
deterministic_metrics.meta_leak: headings, labels, notes to the reader, or prompt echoes detected by checks.py patterns
deterministic_metrics.truncation: done_reason != stop or text not ending in closing punctuation (invariant: must be 0 in accepted output)
deterministic_metrics.unknown_names: capitalized multi-syllable names not in the story bible and not sentence-initial
deterministic_metrics.dialogue_lines: lines or sentences opened by a dialogue mark (—, –, “, ")
deterministic_metrics.schema_valid: structured outputs that validate on the first generation (no repair)
deterministic_metrics.defects_per_1000: (foreign_words + repetition excess + meta_leak + unknown_names + 10*truncation) per 1,000 syllables

judged_metrics.pairwise_l3: blind pairwise preference by the L3 critic prompt (order randomized per pair, A/B labels only); every reason must quote text present verbatim in the preferred output, otherwise the judgment is discarded
judged_metrics.ending_present: manuscript-level: L3 critic answers whether the last chapter resolves the central conflict, with a verbatim quote; outline-level: the outline schema's ending fields are non-empty and the final chapter carries the resolution
judged_metrics.beat_coverage: share of the scene contract's beats that the L2 memo-compliance audit marks covered with a verbatim quote
judged_metrics.finding_precision_recall: for audits and repair: seeded-defect fixtures with known defects; precision and recall of quote-verified findings

winning_rule.invariants: an arm with any CJK, truncation or (structured) invalid final output in an accepted sample loses outright
winning_rule.PARITY: no invariant failure, median defects_per_1000 <= donor median * 1.10, length_window_hit rate >= donor rate - 0.10, and pairwise preference >= 0.40 (ties count 0.5)
winning_rule.IMPROVED: PARITY and at least one of: median defects_per_1000 <= donor median * 0.80, length_window_hit rate >= donor rate + 0.20, pairwise preference >= 0.60
winning_rule.REGRESSED: anything else; the surface is not shipped without an explicit sponsor exception recorded in its parity contract
winning_rule.deterministic_surfaces: S07 apply core and S08 dedupe core: exact-source Node runner on shared fixtures, byte-identical outputs required (PARITY); intentional deviations listed per fixture
